bifrost: springboard/src/shell/desk.rs, springboard/src/shell/splitview.rs, springboard/src/shell/switcher.rs, springboard/src/shell/overview.rs, springboard/sdk/src/screens.rs, springboard/wm
summary: The shell has two modes that already look like the two form factors: floating windows with a dock, and full-screen apps with Split View, Slide Over, a switcher and a home screen. Apps see one surface and a screen list. Apps can open up to eight scene windows through the scenes service, with cascade placement and size restrictions, but the desk does not yet draw a second surface for them, and there is no external display scene and no per-window size class.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.apple: UIWindow, UICoordinateSpace, key window, window level
features.note: a window list service and the shell's window model; every app is a singleton with one window

features.apple: Stage Manager, resizable windows, window controls
features.note: floating windows with traffic lights, move, resize and occlusion; the window server is a Smithay compositor. Tablet-touch move and resize handles are not defined
50/50, 70/30, 30/70 and a 360 pt Slide Over panel with divider drag and swipe away, in handheld mode only
swipe up from the home indicator, cards and go-home flick, in the shell; apps do not see it
desktop overview with a strip of desktops; keyboard driven (Ctrl+Up, F3), no touch gesture is assigned

features.apple: size class changes, multitasking APIs, UIWindowScene.sizeRestrictions
features.note: apps are laid out at the pane size and Layout recomputes; apps cannot set minimum or maximum window sizes through a scene

features.apple: UIWindowScene, multiple windows of one app
features.note: scene windows of one app: open, list, focus, reopen and close, with the shared cascade and size restrictions; built on parity/team-p-scenes; not yet verified on the tablet. Not drawn by the desk yet
screen frames, backing scale and which screen holds a point; no way for an app to put content on another display
Output transform from BIFROST_ROTATION or /etc/bifrost/rotation; the shell's rotate code stays for the orientation switch. Not yet verified on the tablet.
model for the floating video window; related to multitasking
Wayland compositor with DRM and libinput; touch routing, rotation and text input are the convergence work (areas B1, B7, B8)

gaps: Desk surfaces for scene windows (the desk holds one window per app) and the scene windows in the windows list
Touch move and resize of floating windows in desktop mode on a tablet
Touch gesture for the desktop overview
Scene size restrictions and per-window size class
